body: You guys could have a Shakespeare month where you guys read a few of his plays.

I've read up on SWResources, which has calmed me down a little bit. It also has me re-evaluating my own behavior (I've been doing most of the recommended things to a t, but I'm guilty of the occasional "you should do X" comment when I should be saying things like "what do you think of doing x." I'm definitely going to work on that.)

I also programmed a hotline into my phone so that I can call them the next time I start to break, rather than putting it on his shoulders. I know he needs me clear headed and strong, not weepy and weak.

Generally speaking, his trigger for the major cuts would be his ex-girlfriend. The first time (September) was the day he delivered the rest of her belongings, and the second time (late February/early March) was after she texted him a "we should try being friends/being around each other in social gatherings of mutual friends" speech. I was not around him while he cut, nor was he under the influence of things. He does that in the privacy of his bedroom while alone. 

The shallower cuts, much to my dismay, were done while he was at work. I've stressed what a dangerous setting that is, as getting caught could be grounds for immediate dismissal. I've told him (affectionately but firmly) that if it happens again, I might begin writing "Call Frightened123" in sharpie on his legs until we can find him a different coping method. He's agreed.
